zh-CN.title: 处理文字的三条原则
zh-CN.subtitle: 读一段论证时，把注意力留给段落之间的关系。
zh-CN.description: 用相邻两段论证演示图优于文字、清晰优于复杂、直观优于形式。
examples: 顺着箭头，就能看出哪一段在解释另一段。
找回刚才读到的判断，看看作者凭什么这样说。
读者知道下一眼该看哪里。
你翻完脚注，回到原来那一行。
字还认得，却忘了上一段为什么要接到这里。
从这个差别理解：找回位置和接上思路，是两件事。

en.title: Three principles for presenting information
en.subtitle: When reading an argument, keep attention on how its passages fit together.
en.description: Two passages in an argument illustrate visuals over text, clarity over complexity, and intuition over formalism.
examples: Follow the arrow to see which passage explains the other.
Name the action in plain words
Restore the context of the argument
Find the claim you were reading. What reason does the author give?
The reader knows where to look next.
You follow a footnote and return to the same line.
You recognize the words. How did the previous passage lead here?
That difference gives two ideas meaning: finding your place and recovering the thought.
